scope: Mandatory declaration and evidence planning for future Golden References; not retroactive passes for GR01–06.

universal.U01: Repository/schema/registry/authority validation and exact locks; no unintended shared regressions.
universal.U02: Keyboard-only task, logical focus/order, visible focus, names/roles/states, error and feedback reachability.
universal.U03: Actual screen-reader walkthrough of the task and state/feedback changes; automated tree is separate evidence.
universal.U04: Genuine Chrome 200% plus responsive viewport and maximum-content/long-token checks; no document overflow, clipping, destructive overlap or unreachable controls.
universal.U05: Readable contrast/text, semantic structure, non-color cues and reduced-motion preference.
universal.U06: Loading/failure, offline-after-load and honest no-JavaScript fallback; never falsely report completion or storage success.
universal.U07: Separate automated, user-attested and independent semantic provenance; pending direct checks cannot be replaced by emulation.
universal.U08: Human instructional/subject-matter review of authentic capability, limitations, feedback and completion meaning.

conditional.C01: Authored input: physical-mobile software keyboard, IME/multilingual/plain text, focus/scroll, maxima, paste/long tokens, revision invalidation and retained work.
conditional.C02: State/recovery: shared service ownership, refresh recovery, opt-in durable persistence, denial/quota, restore envelope, recomputed completion, conflicts/corruption/clear and privacy.
conditional.C03: Media/illustrations: meaningful alternatives, blocked/slow asset fallback, keyboard access and reduced-motion/static alternatives.
conditional.C04: Comparison/dense evidence: narrow-screen transformation, source traceability, reading order and no horizontal-only dependency.
conditional.C05: Assessment/gates: branch/attempt/feedback/remediation rules, honest limits, no prepared-answer bypass, invalidation and accessible completion signals.
conditional.C06: Export/clipboard/download: complete plain-text representation, safe input, truthful success and denial/fallback behavior.
conditional.C07: Timed/audio/drag/motion interactions if authorized: equivalent untimed/keyboard/text alternatives and interruption/recovery tests.
